name: MediaTek Inc.
blurb: MediaTek Inc. is a global fabless semiconductor company that designs systems-on-chip (SoC) for mobile, home entertainment, connectivity, and IoT markets. It is one of the world's largest chipset suppliers for smartphones and smart TVs, competing with Qualcomm and Samsung. The company also focuses on AI, edge computing, automotive, and 5G/6G technologies. MediaTek is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, and its primary listing is on the Taiwan Stock Exchange (2454.TW).
